posts.title: Return visit to Prague
posts.description: What a joy to be in Prague last month. I loved seeing friends, sights and the sounds of my second home. And the food! Thank you for the warm hugs and kind welcome back. I needed that more than I can put in words.

posts.title: Some Thoughts on Employee Stock Options in 2026
posts.description: Even though I stepped back from my role at Spark, I still spend time with founders and the people who work for them. This post comes from those conversations and from what I keep seeing in my social feeds. It’s a pattern, not a single encounter. Here’s my take. The tech industry loves to say the team is everything.
